query:
-- Verificar exames de 2026 do Denis Santos
SELECT 
  examName, 
  DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-%d') as exam_date,
  value,
  status
FROM exam_history 
WHERE patientId = 'denis-santos' 
  AND YEAR(date) = 2026
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 10;
